title: The Heavenly Secrets Unfold
next_chapter_hook: In the instant the Tianji awakened, Chen Ji glimpsed the full picture of the final battle—next chapter, he would stand atop Kunlun Peak, facing head-on the terrifying existence that coiled above the Nine Heavens.

text.content: That terrifying aura, transcending ten thousand years, descended like an invisible giant hand from the Nine Heavens, crashing down. Chen Ji felt the surrounding heavenly elemental power solidify instantly, even breathing becoming unbearably difficult. On the fifth page of the Tianji Record, runes jumped like living creatures, and an unprecedented light was tearing through the void.

The Tianji Record fragments trembled violently, responding to the descending will. Those who had just sworn their oaths hadn't yet savored victory when this oppressive might forced their faces pale with terror. Ling Yuan's eyes flickered with dread, quickly swallowed by greed—he too sensed the alluring scent of Tianji fragments within that overwhelming power.

dialogue.content: (Coldly smiling) Want to take my Tianji Record? Come right ahead.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, and the first page of the Tianji Record unfurled. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul materialized, his gaze piercing through layers of mist to lock onto that descending terrifying presence. His voice rasped with heavy gravity: "Young Master, the will projection of the Heavenly Eye... it has descended personally. This is both crisis and opportunity for your breakthrough."

Chen Ji's eyes flashed. Mo Xiansheng continued: "You have always observed the Tianji from a quasi-Tianji realm, seemingly powerful but actually constrained everywhere. The descent of the Heavenly Eye will tear a crack in the Three Realms' chessboard—that is the only chance for you to touch the true Tianji realm. But the price..." He paused, "is that your Heavenly Fate Value will be completely drained by seventy percent."

Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, feeling the remaining four hundred-plus points of Heavenly Fate within him. Seventy percent meant nearly three hundred points. This meant after the breakthrough, he would have no retreat, every use of the complete Tianji Record's abilities would be like dancing on a knife's edge.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! What are you doing!

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice rang from the distance, sensing the gathering destructive pressure. She wanted to rush over, but Ling Yuan's barrier blocked her path. Her silver teeth clenched tight, beautiful eyes filled with worry and confusion—why did thistrash always insist on risking his life in such reckless pursuits?

dialogue.content: (Looking at Su Qingyao, a slight smile) Senior Sister Su, in this battle, I need you to buy me three breaths of time.

text.content: Su Qingyao froze. Three breaths? What was he planning? But without hesitation, her sword sang from its sheath, sword intent soaring to the heavens: "trash, you better come back alive!"

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's will projection was descending—this was the sole chance to break through the Tianji realm. Three breaths of time, Chen Ji had to make a choice:

choices.description: Using the power of the Tianji Record fragments to stabilize oneself, gradually comprehending Tianji laws under pressure. While steady, it might miss the optimal breakthrough timing.
choices.risk_hint: May fail to breakthrough, wasting the opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, the first page of the Tianji Record slowly rotating. A hundred points of Heavenly Fate Value surged forth like a tide, forming a stabilizing barrier around him. He closed his eyes, concentrating, feeling the fragments of Tianji laws within that terrifying pressure.

However, at this moment, the Heavenly Eye's will let out a cold laugh. In the void, an eye formed entirely from pure heavenly laws slowly opened, its icy gaze piercing through all barriers and locking directly onto Chen Ji. "Interesting little creature... let me see how long you can endure."

Ling Yuan, seizing this opportunity, actually began to activate his barrier, wanting to completely seal Chen Ji before his breakthrough. His calculation was clever—as long as he could interrupt Chen Ji's breakthrough, he could claim the Tianji Record's fortune all for himself.

choices.description: Directly using Heavenly Fate Value as a guide, forcibly absorbing the law fluctuations generated during the Heavenly Eye's descent. A single breakthrough, but extremely high risk, possible backlash.
choices.visible_reward: Break through to the Heavenly Secrets realm and obtain the complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk of backlash, possible severe injury

text.content: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he made his decision. He forcefully activated the Tianji Record, and the Heavenly Fate within his body rushed out like a flood breaking through a dam, transforming into a brilliant pillar of light that shot straight toward the sky. 'Since we're breaking through, let's break through completely!'

The will projection of the Heavenly Dao's Eye clearly paused, then let out an angry roar: 'Insolent!' That eye pupil condensed from laws suddenly expanded, and a destructive force surged forth like a tide. But around Chen Ji, page after page of the Tianji Record fragments unfolded simultaneously, forming a brilliant barrier.

Just at this moment, a shadowy figure silently appeared behind Chen Ji—it was Ye Qing. She held a bronze mirror with flowing dark light, and demonic path mists silently spread, completely concealing Chen Ji's presence. 'Chen Ji, this is what I owed you when you saved me before... now I'm returning it to you.' Her voice was cold yet carried a hint of imperceptible gentleness.

choices.description: Awaken the residual souls of past prophets sleeping within the Tianji Record, using their combined power to assault the Heavenly Secrets realm. Highest success rate, but will consume the Tianji Record's heritage.
choices.visible_reward: Stable breakthrough, complete version mysteries revealed

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze slightly condensed as he made another choice. He forcefully activated the core of the Tianji Record, using the author's authority to awaken the residual souls of past prophets sleeping on the fifth and sixth pages. 'Respected predecessors, lend me your power!'

In the void, ancient and majestic auras awakened one after another. The silhouettes of past prophets slowly emerged, their gazes complex as they looked at Chen Ji—the young man chosen by the Tianji Record. 'Interesting... the author of this generation is actually so young.' An elderly phantom with white hair nodded slightly.

Ling Yuan's expression completely changed. He never imagined that so many ancient beings were sealed within the Tianji Record. The prohibitions he had set up were as fragile as paper before those residual souls' aura. 'Impossible! How is this possible!' His voice carried a tremor.

Su Qingyao's sword light swept across the sky like a white ribbon, shattering Ling Yuan's formations in just three breaths. Her arms were torn and bleeding from the backlash, yet she didn't even furrow her brow. 'Wastrel! You better keep your word!' Her voice carried a slight tremor, but it was filled with determination.

Chen Ji smiled faintly, then his expression grew serious. He formed seals with both hands, and all the fragments of the Tianji Record glowed brilliantly. The over 400 points of Heavenly Fate within his body burned fiercely, like a grand fireworks display blooming within him. The power of the past prophets' residual souls flowed into his Mental Sea like trickling streams, and at that moment, he felt a realm unprecedented before.

The sixth page, seventh page, eighth page of the Tianji Record... pages never before revealed unfolded one after another. Chen Ji felt his spiritual sense expanding frantically, from ten li, to a hundred li, then to a thousand li... The entire region where the Tianqing Sect was located became clearly visible within his perception.

dialogue.content: So this is... the true Heavenly Secrets realm?

text.content: He closed his eyes, feeling that全新的境界. In the quasi-Heavenly Secrets realm, he could only foresee three hours ahead, his vision like a well. Now, he seemed to stand above the Nine Heavens, looking down at the three realms' chessboard, every piece's position and every thread of cause and effect crystal clear.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Secrets opened initially, and Chen Ji felt unprecedented power flooding into his body. However, the will projection of the Heavenly Dao's Eye had not dissipated but become even more violent. He had to make a choice:

choices.description: Seize the opportunity while the Heavenly Dao's Eye's will projection is still unstable, and directly destroy it with the newly breakthrough power. Extremely high risk, but if successful, it will greatly weaken the Heavenly Dao's Eye's布局.
choices.visible_reward: Destroy the Heavenly Dao's Eye projection, obtain a large amount of Heavenly Dao law fragments
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may have other tricks up its sleeve

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, galaxies swirling in his pupils. He raised his hand, the ninth page of the Tianji Record unfurled, and a brilliant sword light condensed from nothingness—that was a sword of Heavenly Secrets forged from pure Heavenly Secret laws. 'Since you're here, don't expect to leave.'

The will projection of the Eye of Heavenly Dao let out an enraged roar: 'A mere ant dares to defy heaven!' That law-congealed eye pupil suddenly expanded, and a devastating power surged forth like a tide. Yet, Chen Ji merely raised his hand lightly, and that sword of Heavenly Secrets pierced through the void, thrusting straight toward that eye pupil.

A mournful wail echoed through the three realms. The will projection of the Eye of Heavenly Dao was pierced by a single sword thrust, and countless law fragments scattered and flew in all directions. Before those fragments could dissipate, the Tianji Record absorbed them all. Chen Ji felt a surge of immense power flowing into his body, his realm completely stabilized at the early Tianji Realm.

choices.description: Temporarily spare the projection of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, focusing on stabilizing the newly broken-through realm. While strength won't immediately improve dramatically, the foundation becomes more solid.
choices.visible_cost: Lost the opportunity to defeat the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Realm stabilized, subsequent breakthroughs become easier
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may recover and counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji did not pursue glory recklessly. He understood that after breaking through, his realm was not yet stable. Charging forward rashly might give the Eye of Heavenly Dao an opportunity. He suppressed his aura and began to stabilize his newly breakthrough realm.

The will projection of the Eye of Heavenly Dao let out a cold snort, seemingly surprised by Chen Ji's choice: 'At least you have some self-awareness.' That eye pupil slowly dissipated, but before it vanished, it left behind a cold voice: 'Chen Ji... I've remembered you. The next time we meet will be your death.'

A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. The Eye of Heavenly Dao? Remembering him? He murmured to himself: 'Many people remember me. Who do you think you are?' At this moment, his tone carried absolute confidence and dominance, completely different from his previous waste of a person persona.

choices.description: Deliberately show weakness, letting the Eye of Heavenly Dao believe that he has exhausted all his options, while secretly leaving a Tianji mark within its projection as a hidden thread for future tracking.
choices.visible_reward: Embed a tracking mark within the Eye of Heavenly Dao's main body
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, may suffer severe backlash

text.content: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he made his third choice. He deliberately made his aura chaotic, showing an exhausted appearance, while secretly channeling the Tianji Record, leaving an extremely fine Tianji mark within the dissipating will projection.

The will projection of the Eye of Heavenly Dao let out a mocking sound: 'Nothing more than this.' It did not go all out, only leaving a cold voice: 'Your fate has been marked. The next time we meet will be the time of harvest.' With that, that eye pupil completely dissipated.

Only after that will had completely vanished did Chen Ji reveal his true smile. He raised his hand, and a Tianji mark as fine as a hair flickered subtly between his fingertips. 'Harvest? I hope next time we meet, you can withstand my harvest.' At this moment, his impeccable calculation was displayed to the fullest.

Ling Yuan's expression had gone beyond mere ugliness. He had watched Chen Ji break through from the quasi-Tianji realm to the true Tianji realm with his own eyes, watched the will projection of the Eye of Heavenly Dao be repelled or toyed with, yet could do nothing. That waste... no, that monster! His hands were trembling, from rage, and more from unwillingness.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! You think breaking through the Tianji realm makes you my enemy? You're just a waste!

text.content: Chen Ji slowly turned around, his gaze toward Ling Yuan as if looking at an ant. He spoke calmly: 'Sect Master Ling, how did it feel when the Tianji Record abandoned you back then?' These words were like a blade, stabbing directly into Ling Yuan's deepest wound.

dialogue.content: Those chosen are not necessarily the strong, but those abandoned... must have problems.

text.content: Ling Yuan's face instantly twisted, the flames of rage almost burning him to ashes. He forcefully channeled all his cultivation, and a world-destroying attack crashed toward Chen Ji: 'You little beast! I'll make you perish both body and spirit!'

dialogue.content: (Raising his hand gently) Sect Master Ling, you're too impatient.

text.content: Just as the attack was about to reach Chen Ji, something strange occurred. Ling Yuan's attack actually decomposed in mid-air, breaking into countless tiny elemental fragments that were completely absorbed by the Tianji Record. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his robes fluttering gracefully, as if he had just done something trivial. 'Is this the strength you've used to suppress me for all these years? To be honest, I'm somewhat disappointed.'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's attack was easily neutralized, and his mind was now in great turmoil. Chen Ji had already broken through to the Heavenly Secrets realm, and with the complete Tianji Record in hand, his combat power was no longer what it used to be. Now, he needed to decide how to deal with this old rival:

choices.text: Uproot the weeds and eliminate the roots
choices.description: While Ling Yuan's mind is in chaos, strike directly and kill him to eliminate all future troubles. One clean solution, but it might provoke backlash from others in the Tianqing Sect.
choices.visible_reward: Kill Ling Yuan, eliminate the greatest hidden danger

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes turned cold, and killing intent instantly spread throughout the entire area. He didn't want to give Ling Yuan any chance to turn the tables. This old thing had been coveting the Tianji Record for years—who knows what other hidden moves he might still have? Now that they've already torn apart all pretense, he absolutely couldn't leave any hidden dangers.

The Sword of Heavenly Secrets condensed once more, this time with countless law patterns coiling around the blade. Chen Ji raised his hand, and sword light like an inverted Milky Way slashed directly toward Ling Yuan. 'Sect Master Ling, your era... has ended.'

Ling Yuan let out a shrill scream; his protective spiritual light was as fragile as paper before the Sword of Heavenly Secrets. The sword light pierced through his chest, and a strange force began eroding his meridians. 'No! I am the Sect Master of Tianqing Sect! I refuse to accept this!' His voice was filled with unwillingness and fear.

choices.description: Severely injure Ling Yuan but spare his life, letting him survive in fear and humiliation. This would not only deter other insignificant troublemakers but also give himself one more controllable piece.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan may recover and seek revenge
choices.visible_reward: One more controllable piece, stronger deterrent effect

text.content: Chen Ji turned his sword blade, not striking Ling Yuan's vital point but instead sealing all his meridians. An excruciating pain made Ling Yuan nearly faint; his cultivation instantly dropped from the Transformation God realm to Foundation Building, decades of arduous cultivation destroyed in an instant.

'Sect Master Ling, I spare your life.' Chen Ji's voice was cold and clear. 'Didn't you always want to know what it feels like to be abandoned by the Tianji Record? Now, you finally have the chance to experience it slowly.'

Ling Yuan knelt on the ground, his eyes filled with despair and madness. He knew that from now on, he was no longer the lofty Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, but a cripple publicly humiliated by a piece of trash. 'Chen Ji... you'll die a horrible death!'

Chen Ji smiled lightly: 'Die? I will live much longer than you can imagine. Rest assured, I will let you watch as I ascend to the pinnacle step by step.' With that, he turned and left, leaving behind a dashing silhouette.

choices.description: Using the power of the Tianji Record, plant a Heavenly Secrets mark in Ling Yuan's soul, completely subjugating him as a puppet. Although the consumption is significant, it can gain a powerful enforcer.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a Transformation God realm puppet

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered as he made another decision. With his hands forming seals, the Tianji Record flipped to a newly revealed tenth page—on it was recorded a long-lost Tianji Slave Seal. "Sect Master Ling, since fate has brought us together, why not become master and servant?"

Ling Yuan's face changed drastically: "You're insane! I am the Sect Master of Tianqing Sect! A Mahayana Stage Great Master!" Yet Chen Ji merely smiled faintly as the Tianji Slave Seal crashed down, piercing directly through Ling Yuan's soul defense and sinking into the depths of his Mental Sea.

A piercing scream echoed through the entire scene. Ling Yuan felt his soul bound by an invisible chain, his life, death, glory, and disgrace now entirely at Chen Ji's whims. "M-Master..." His voice was full of resentment and humiliation, yet under the suppression of the Tianji Slave Seal, he had to lower his proud head.

Su Qingyao stared blankly at everything before her. That waste of a junior brother she had once despised now stood with hands clasped behind his back, surrounded by the light of Heavenly Secrets laws, like a deity descending from the heavenly realm. Her heart was pounding violently, uncertain whether it was from shock or something else entirely.

Chen Ji turned to face Su Qingyao. This woman had thrice come dangerously close to the truth, and three times he had resolved it. Now he no longer needed to conceal anything. Perhaps... it was time to give her an answer. "Senior Sister Su, do you want to know who I am?"

dialogue.content: (A slight smile) I am Chen Ji, a servant disciple of Tianqing Sect, the author of the Tianji Record... and the one destined to overturn this heavenly chess game.

text.content: Su Qingyao opened her mouth, but no words came out. She reminisced about all those moments when she'd thought him a waste, yet he'd always escaped danger; all those times she'd dismissed as coincidences, which upon deeper reflection seemed terrifyingly calculated... So from the very beginning, this man had been manipulating her like a chess piece.

dialogue.content: (Her beautiful eyes filled with complexity) "You... hid yourself so deeply."

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, approaching Su Qingyao and whispering near her ear: "Senior Sister Su, you are one of the smartest women I've ever met. Being able to approach the truth three times is proof enough of your keenness." He paused, "But you made one mistake—I never intended to deceive you. I was simply... waiting for the right moment."

Chen Ji met her gaze directly, his tone serious: "Waiting for... the moment you're willing to stand on my side." His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable conviction, "Senior Sister Su, in the chaos ahead, no one can remain uninvolved. I need you."

Su Qingyao's heart quivered violently. This man never followed conventional paths. She had assumed she would be his enemy, an obstacle he would need to eliminate. Yet he was actually... inviting her? "Aren't you afraid I'm here to investigate you? Aren't you afraid I'll expose you?" Her voice grew hoarse.

dialogue.content: (A soft laugh) "Senior Sister Su, if you truly wanted to expose me, you had the chance three years ago. You didn't... which means you were waiting for me to give you a reason."

text.content: This sentence struck like a thunderbolt through Su Qingyao's heart. Indeed, she had sensed something was wrong long ago but never reported it. What had she been waiting for? She didn't even know herself. Perhaps... she too was waiting for a reason that would make her willing to follow. "Chen Ji..." Her voice carried a tremor, "What exactly do you intend to do?"

Chen Ji raised his head to gaze at the sky, where the void fissure he had torn during his breakthrough remained visible, and further in the distance, the faint outline of the Kunlun Summit could be seen. "I will reshape the chessboard of the three realms." His voice wasn't loud, yet carried an aura of dominance over all under heaven, "Senior Sister Su, would you like to witness this with me?"

Su Qingyao fell silent. This man had given her too many shocks—his deep scheming, far-reaching strategies, and overwhelming strength completely exceeded her imagination. But precisely because of this, that不甘心的劲头反而被激发了出来。"好。" She took a deep breath, determination flashing in her beautiful eyes, "I, Su Qingyao, am willing to walk with you. But remember—"

dialogue.content: "If you dare deceive me, even if I die, Su Qingyao will drag you to the grave with me!"

text.content: Chen Ji was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter. This woman was indeed interesting. "Senior Sister Su, rest assured—I, Chen Ji, never deceive my own people." He extended his hand, "From today onward, you and I are allies sharing the same fate. At the Kunlun Summit, let's go see the scenery of that final battle together."

Su Qingyao looked at the hand extended toward her, hesitated for a moment, then finally grasped it. The instant their palms touched, a strange light flickered between them—it was the scene automatically recorded by the Tianji Record, eternally capturing this moment. "Let's go." Chen Ji smiled faintly, "Next stop, the Kunlun Summit."

Just then, the eleventh page of the Tianji Record suddenly unfolded, revealing a blurry image upon it—on the Kunlun Summit, a massive formation was slowly taking shape, and at its center, the faint figure of a young girl could be seen, bound by countless chains. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that was... Chen Nian! His own sister! The Heavenly Fate Lock Key he had been searching for all these years!

dialogue.content: (Killing intent boiling in his eyes) "Chen Nian... I'm coming."

text.content: Heavenly Secrets initially opened, author's permissions reaching their peak. Chen Ji could finally fully perceive every corner of the three-realm chess game, and his sister Chen Nian was right at the center of the formation on the Kunlun Summit, waiting for his rescue. "Master Mo." He called out in his heart, "Can you now tell me the secrets of the complete Tianji Record?"

dialogue.content: (The faint shadow of a remnant soul appeared) "Young master, the complete Tianji Record has thirteen pages in total, recording all Heavenly Secrets laws from the creation of the three realms until now. You have now opened eleven pages... The secret of the final page requires you to uncover it personally."

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his gaze burning like fire. "Kunlun Summit... Heavenly Eye of Fate... Chen Nian..." His voice was low yet resolute, "This chess game, I, Chen Ji, accept." He turned around, taking one last look at the chaotic battlefield behind him, where Ling Yuan lay seriously wounded or subjugated, along with those terrified Tianqing Sect disciples. "Everyone, until we meet again."

With those words, he gathered Su Qingyao and transformed into a streak of light, soaring into the heavens and racing toward Kunlun's Summit. Behind him, the Tianji Record slowly unfurled, and the prophetic visions on its eleventh and twelfth pages grew ever clearer—there, a final battle that would determine the fate of the Three Realms was about to unfold. And Chen Ji, as the chronicler, would personally take up his brush to inscribe this unprecedented game of cosmic chess.
